project_metadata.job_description:
PPC Audit for brand new account. 

For Stephen Fitz only

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Please add me to Google Ads:
Visit [URL_001]
Select the Admin Gear Icon in the bottom-left corner
Choose Access and Security
Use the blue button to add [EMAIL_001] with read-only access
If you are required to complete a 2FA task, the invite may need to be sent a second time before it goes through.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For some background, I haven't launched any campaigns yet. I only attempted to put one together, then realized it would be better to speak with an expert.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Understood. An audit is generally used to review past / current performance. Instead, I can review your account and website, then recommend a plan outlining what I would do to scale your results.
Would that work for you?
[CLIENT_NAME_001] audit what you've drafted as well.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Some additional context: I am specifically targeting people seeking estate planning services, rather than other estate law services such as estate administration, probate, elder law, etc. I was a little confused when the forecast indicated that ROAS would fall sharply at a spend of $2,000 or more. It seemed odd that, despite targeting a fairly large geographic area (all of New Jersey, and the affluent Philly suburb counties), I could only generate 20 monthly form fills (and maybe 3 conversions). Still, perhaps that really is the limit? Or maybe the forecast tool is not accurate before a campaign launches? Once you've had an opportunity to review it, please tell me what is even possible to determine at this stage.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001] - I just noticed that we never set a deadline. There’s no rush; would Friday work?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hi [CLIENT_NAME_002], I've completed the audit and buildout proposal.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Thanks, and please reach out if you have any follow-up questions.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001] - everything looks good. I have one question before we begin. I’m definitely comfortable starting at $2k per month to test the water, but do you think there is potential to scale? I realize we'll know more after gathering data for the few months, though I’m curious about what you can tell at this point.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Aside from that question, I am ready to move forward with the 7 hour buildout.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I’ll go in and correct the layout problem that appears on wide screens.
